paper: Compact 3D Gaussian Representation for Radiance Field
headline: Decoded Ours+PP within 0.5 dB on 3/3 mip360 scenes (bicycle 24.63/24.73, garden 26.35/26.72, bonsai 31.94/31.98); delta vs gsplat -0.29/-0.55/+0.05 vs paper vs 3DGS* -0.37/-0.53/-0.18. Storage Ours+PP 53.99/43.35/19.67 MB vs paper 42.42/43.26/16.40 (7-35% more Gaussians). Gaps: fp32 vs tcnn fp16, white bg/gsplat, update order, global state via fields; no G-PCC (paper uses fp16 positions).
